checks.proof: M>=2^50, h<1 imply ell_actual=ceil(M^100*h^-4)>=2^5000; hence ell0=ell_actual-1>=8.
The third derivative bound 32 gives (32/3)*8^3*2^-500; the additional delta^2 correction is smaller than 2^-1990; their sum is below 2^-480.
0<=sigma<=1; e<3; initial integral<e^2<9; rInitial<77/8<10, rDecay<10, entry integral<3, rEntry<13, rEq<2.
K1<4e^T and initial integral<9 imply Jshape<149e^T/2<128e^T; 4XR*e<mConst<4XR*e^(T+1).
H8, H4 and monotone XH give |D_I|/(XH)<=1024/X0I2, including the complete improper tail.
Gamma<=2; e^2<9; 1-exp(-a)>=a/2 for a<=1; log(1+Z)>=Z/3 for Z<=2; integrate y in [1/2,1] and v in [1,2].
Each of seven absolute terms is less than 2^(-bits-3); their sum is less than 2^-bits.
CSelected>2 and C12EnvelopeR=exp(CSelected^25600000)>exp(2^100); hence u_star=2*C12EnvelopeR^10 has 0<u_star^-1<2^-1000. This uses the actual envelope, not merely M>=2^50.
The source T=exp(Md)+10 is greater than 10, so 0<sqrt(lambda)=exp(-500*T)<2^-1000.
